school_name: The University of Texas at Austin

boards.school_name: The University of Texas at Austin
boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Guadalupe Street and nearby West Campus corridors, each with a direct source for its stated reason.

cards.title: Course-material stop
cards.subtitle: Guadalupe Street (The Drag)
cards.notes: Use the store’s course-material section for textbooks, supplies, courseware, art materials, lab equipment, and scrubs; check its current store-hours page first.
cards.short_summary: An off-campus UT-linked retailer for academic materials.
cards.evidence_claim: UT identifies the University Co-op at 2246 Guadalupe Street and lists textbooks, supplies, courseware, art supplies, lab equipment, and scrubs as eligible course-material purchases.
cards.source_title: University Co-op Textbooks and Course Materials Programs
cards.access_notes: Store hours and temporary exceptions are posted by the Co-op.

cards.title: Attend a listed service
cards.subtitle: Guadalupe Street (The Drag)
cards.notes: Check the parish schedule before heading over for daily or Sunday Mass; the parish lists its address, service times, and office hours on its site.
cards.short_summary: A historic parish immediately south of the UT edge.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Austin lists daily Mass at 8:00 a.m. and multiple Sunday Masses at its 2026 Guadalupe Street location near UT.
cards.access_notes: Service and office schedules are published by the parish; confirm holiday changes before visiting.

cards.title: Find a campus-edge congregation
cards.subtitle: Guadalupe Street (The Drag)
cards.notes: Use the church’s own site to review its current gatherings and contact details before visiting the building at 2130 Guadalupe Street.
cards.short_summary: A named church destination on the Drag corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: University Baptist Church lists its address as 2130 Guadalupe Street, Austin, Texas 78705.
cards.access_notes: Review the church’s current calendar or contact information before planning a visit.

cards.title: Join a no-cost Shabbat dinner
cards.subtitle: San Antonio Street, beside the Guadalupe corridor
cards.notes: Students can check Texas Hillel’s event information, then attend its weekly Shabbat dinner; the organization says the dinner is open to all students at no cost.
cards.short_summary: A student Jewish-life center with a documented free weekly dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Hillel says it hosts weekly Shabbat dinner, open to all students at no cost, at 2105 San Antonio Street.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the event date and any registration details through Texas Hillel before attending.

cards.title: Order all-day breakfast
cards.subtitle: Guadalupe Street (The Drag)
cards.notes: Choose this Guadalupe location when you want the restaurant’s all-day breakfast menu; use its locations page to confirm the day’s hours before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A University-area Kerbey Lane location with all-day service.
cards.evidence_claim: Kerbey Lane lists its University location at 2606 Guadalupe and describes the company as an all-day breakfast, brunch, lunch, and dinner restaurant.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Sunday–Thursday 7 a.m.–10 p.m. and Friday–Saturday 7 a.m.–midnight; verify holiday changes.

cards.title: Choose a halal Mediterranean meal
cards.subtitle: Guadalupe Street (The Drag)
cards.notes: Review the cafe’s menu options before you go; it identifies meat-over-rice plates, vegetarian and vegan plates, wraps, soups, salads, and desserts.
cards.short_summary: A near-UT cafe with halal Mediterranean and plant-based choices.
cards.evidence_claim: Kismet Cafe describes itself as a halal Mediterranean restaurant near UT Austin with meat, vegetarian, and vegan plates, wraps, soup, salads, and desserts.
cards.access_notes: Check the cafe’s current online information before visiting.

cards.title: Pick up poutine or a sandwich
cards.subtitle: Guadalupe Street (The Drag)
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s direct ordering page to check the live menu and pickup status before heading to its 2716½ Guadalupe Street location.
cards.short_summary: A Guadalupe Street food stop with direct pickup ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: Mighty Mo’s direct ordering page lists its Guadalupe location at 2716½ Guadalupe Street and includes poutine, burgers, and cheesesteaks on its menu.
cards.access_notes: The ordering page displays current pickup availability and hours.

cards.title: Build a Baja-style order
cards.subtitle: Rio Grande Street, beside the Guadalupe corridor
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to select pickup and check the current hours for this Rio Grande location before making the short walk from campus.
cards.short_summary: A Rio Grande Street location for burritos, tacos, bowls, and salads.
cards.evidence_claim: Cabo Bob’s lists its Austin–Rio Grande location at 2828 Rio Grande Street and offers burritos, tacos, bowls, nachos, salads, and quesadillas.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday–Saturday hours of 10:30 a.m.–10:05 p.m. and Sunday closure; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Plan for bakery or dinner service
cards.subtitle: Rio Grande Street, beside the Guadalupe corridor
cards.notes: Check the bakery’s day-specific schedule before visiting; it lists daytime service every day and dinner service Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Rio Grande bakery with separate daytime and dinner windows.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas French Bread lists its address as 2900 Rio Grande Street and posts daytime hours daily plus Tuesday–Saturday dinner service.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours vary by day; consult the official schedule before going.

cards.title: Shop a community-owned co-op
cards.subtitle: Guadalupe Street, north of the Drag
cards.notes: Visit the Guadalupe store for grocery and deli shopping while it remains open; the co-op advises that this location’s lease ends on December 31, 2026.
cards.short_summary: A community-owned grocery co-op north of campus with a planned 2026 closure.
cards.evidence_claim: Wheatsville states that its Guadalupe store will remain open until its lease ends on December 31, 2026, unless circumstances change.
cards.access_notes: Wheatsville lists Guadalupe store hours as 8 a.m.–9 p.m.; verify current operating status because a 2026 closure is planned.
